# VaultBox

> VaultBox is an encrypted private photo, video and document vault for iPhone and iPad.

Official website: https://vaultbox.pacsix.com/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vaultbox-hide-secret-photos/id6758970966
Developer: Pack6 LLC
Last reviewed: 2026-08-14

## Core product facts

- Product type: iOS privacy and security application.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad.
- Minimum system: iOS 17.0 or later and iPadOS 17.0 or later.
- File protection: AES-256-GCM encryption for private photos, videos, documents and thumbnails.
- Access protection: a separate private PIN with optional Face ID access.
- Disguises: working calculator, notes, weather and clock covers.
- Additional controls: decoy vault, break-in alerts, encrypted iCloud backup and expiring encrypted share links.
- Availability: free to download with optional in-app purchases for advanced protections.

## Data and privacy

- VaultBox encrypts private file content on the user's device.
- Optional encrypted backup is stored in the user's iCloud account.
- Product analytics may record event names but do not contain the user's private photos, videos, documents or the content inside them.
- Privacy policy: https://vaultbox.pacsix.com/privacy/

## What VaultBox is not

- VaultBox is not an app hider for other installed apps.
- VaultBox is not a social network.
- VaultBox does not operate a cloud photo gallery for users' private libraries.
